text: At startup, Steward loads candidate adapter manifests, requires `schema_version`, `type`, `name`, `implementation_version`, and `interface_version`, and checks interface compatibility. The supported `interface_version` shown for `worker`, `oracle`, `sandbox`, `store`, and `exporter` is `1`; required adapter mismatches raise `ADAPTER_INTERFACE_MISMATCH` and abort startup, while optional adapters only warn and continue in disabled-feature mode. The registration API is `register`, `set_default`, `resolve`, and `list`.
